definitions.explanation: A male child. A formal or official word used on documents, in news, and in set phrases rather than in casual speech.

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}な{男児|だんじ}が{生|う}まれた。
{第一子|だいいっし}は{男児|だんじ}だった。
examples.english: Their first child was a boy.

examples.japanese: 「{日本男児|にほんだんじ}」という{言葉|ことば}には{古|ふる}い{価値観|かちかん}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The phrase "a Japanese man" carries old-fashioned values.

notes:
Formal and official; common in birth announcements and news. Everyday speech uses {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男児|だんじ}を{出産|しゅっさん}する: to give birth to a boy
- {日本男児|にほんだんじ}: a Japanese man (with connotations of manliness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}: boy — everyday, neutral
- {女児|じょじ}: female child — the female counterpart
